sloka: किम्प्रमाणमिदं काव्यं का प्रतिष्ठा महात्मनः ।कर्ता काव्यस्य महतः क्व चासौ मुनिपुङ्गवः ।। ७.९४.२३ ॥
transliteration: kimpramāṇamidaṁ kāvyaṁ kā pratiṣṭhā mahātmanaḥ ।kartā kāvyasya mahataḥ kva cāsau munipuṅgavaḥ ।। 7.94.23 ॥

translations.english: Rama inquired about the length of this poem, the fame of its great author, and the whereabouts of that foremost sage who composed this great work.
